toolchain.numeric_core: decimal.Decimal, precision 34, ROUND_HALF_EVEN; integer/rational arithmetic where exact
toolchain.randomness: forbidden for acceptance; Monte Carlo may illustrate but cannot replace enumerated worst cases
toolchain.network: forbidden during regeneration; external documents are provenance inputs, not runtime dependencies

input_contract.rounding: round only for presentation; evaluate pass/fail before presentation rounding

methods.method: Decimal interval arithmetic over min/max tolerances plus explicit discrete operating modes
methods.anti_shortcut: typical values may be reported but can never prove a pass

methods.method: closed-form KCL/KVL and efficiency/loss envelopes evaluated at every legal source/load state
methods.anti_shortcut: rail loads may not be hidden in an aggregate unexplained allowance

methods.method: piecewise-linear or datasheet behavioral state model with Decimal time base, explicit initial conditions and dt/dt2 convergence check
methods.anti_shortcut: a waveform without input provenance, timestep convergence and threshold markers is non-evidence

methods.method: deterministic enumeration of legal states, single faults, watchdog deadlines and recovery transitions
methods.anti_shortcut: nominal happy-path simulation cannot close a safety requirement

methods.method: level/pull/leakage/back-power predicates and worst-case timing/occupancy algebra for each interface
methods.anti_shortcut: logic-family labels do not replace VIH/VIL/VOH/VOL and power-off behavior

methods.method: source-to-antenna 50-ohm loss/mismatch budget plus reference-plane, corridor, isolation and coexistence constraints
methods.anti_shortcut: pre-layout calculation cannot claim final impedance, isolation or radiated performance; those remain H6/H8

methods.method: worst-case dissipation and bounded thermal-resistance/capacitance network for board, enclosure and cells
methods.anti_shortcut: unknown enclosure or interface resistance is a range, never a guessed scalar

methods.method: machine join from every requirement and H2 net/device identity to an H3 result and downstream physical measurement
methods.anti_shortcut: an unlinked result does not close a requirement

pass_fail_rules.rule: Every normal and allowed degraded corner stays inside manufacturer recommended operating conditions; absolute maximum ratings are never design targets.
Steady rail/source current has at least 25% reserve over the enumerated worst-case load; exceptions require a named transient-only rating and separate H3.2 proof.
A regulated rail retains at least 5% of nominal-voltage headroom after source tolerance, distribution loss and steady droop, while every load remains inside its own supply range.
Worst-case timing and shared-resource occupancy use no more than 80% of the allocated deadline/budget; independent dedicated buses are checked for latency but are not combined artificially.
Power-off, reset and quiet-state combinations produce no back-power or unintended transmitter enable; any non-zero injection must remain below the exact published limit with 2x analytical reserve.
Predicted silicon junction temperature remains at least 20 C below the applicable maximum; battery charge/discharge temperature remains at least 10 C inside the exact cell/charger operating boundary.
Every enumerated single fault reaches a bounded-energy safe state without relying on the same firmware domain that may have failed, while a retained diagnostic reason remains recoverable.
Transient numerical evidence must agree at dt and dt/2 within 10% of the remaining pass margin; otherwise the timestep is reduced or the result fails unresolved.
RF pre-layout results pass only as layout constraints and loss/isolation budgets; final 50-ohm, matching, VNA, spectrum and coexistence claims remain H6/H8 measurements.
A missing min/max tolerance, applicability condition or model provenance is a fail/unresolved result, never an assumed pass.

reproducibility.regeneration_order: H3-VRF01 -> H3-VRF02 -> H3-VRF03 -> numbered H3 calculation artifacts
